output.reason: The cited bullet [ev-c54e318d2da0] is only a metric name, but its section introduction [ev-1f419676f177] states the change concretely. Metrics that started with `cortex_` are renamed to start with `loki_` in this release, so this metric becomes `loki_frontend_query_range_duration_seconds_count`. Environments are exposed when `metrics_namespace` is left at its new default `loki`; setting it to `cortex` keeps the old name. That same section says `metrics_namespace` is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. The consequence follows directly: the metric is no longer published under the `cortex_` name, so anything that queries that name gets no data. That is enough to write the subject, change, applicability and consequence.
